items.title: 未必是美夢！邁威爾收購Lumentum市值蒸發千億美元 巴隆點出特斯拉與SpaceX投資人也該警惕
items.title_en: Not Necessarily a Dream! Marvell’s $100 Billion Market‑Cap Loss After Acquiring Lumentum, Barron Warns Tesla and SpaceX Investors to Be Cautious
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)投資人無不高度期待能與SpaceX(SPCX-US)合併，預期後者將以全股票交易方式溢價收購，進而推升特斯拉股價。但巴隆周刊(Barron’s)認為，在特斯拉投資人準備兌現這筆交易帶來的收益之前，應該先了解邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)與Lumentum(LITE-US)兩家公司股價發生的事。
邁威爾周一(2日)同意以全股票交易方式收購Lumentum，對後者的估值為每股1,132美元，較10月28日收盤價溢價24%。按照目前交易條件，Lumentum股東每持有1股Lumentum股票，將取得4.5股邁威爾股票。
但消息公布後，當天市場反應冷淡，Lumentum周一重挫近19%，收在每股684.40美元，邁威爾股價也下跌近13%，收在每股171.41美元。
換句話說，邁威爾同意以每股1,132美元收購Lumentum，但截至周一收盤，Lumentum股價已比這個價格低了約40%。邁威爾股價也較10月28日收盤價251.65美元下跌逾30%。
市場顯然非常不看好這筆交易。兩家公司合併後的總市值，已從10月28日約3,300億美元，降至周一的2,300億美元。這筆交易意在整合人工智慧(AI)資料中心擴建潮核心的高階晶片與高階光學連接器製造業務，卻讓兩家公司合計蒸發約1,000億美元市值。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳6月曾暗示，邁威爾的價值可能達到1兆美元。邁威爾市值以周一收盤價計算約為1,500億美元，股價則比6月創下的52周高點329.88美元下跌近50%。
巴隆指出，通常當投資人看好一筆併購交易時，合併後公司的總價值也會提高，發揮一加一大於二的效果。而當企業價值上升時，投資人可以檢視交易預期創造的綜效金額，並與市值增幅比較，以判斷市場反應是否合理。
這筆交易中，兩家公司預料將創造10億美元綜效，但以合併後市值變化(蒸發1000億美元)計算，綜效倍數為負100倍。
投資人反對這筆交易有幾個原因，包括漫長的監管審查、讓製造商(Lumentum)與晶片設計商(邁威爾)合併的作法不尋常，以及股權稀釋問題。
全股票併購交易並不保證被收購公司的股價會上漲，交易完成後，這些股票的價值將與收購方股價連動。
投資人目前對SpaceX和特斯拉的預期是，SpaceX可能提出20%或30%的溢價，把特斯拉股價推升至500美元
巴隆認為，雖然SpaceX與特斯拉的投資人很可能會大力支持馬斯克打造垂直整合AI公司的願景，但從邁威爾和Lumentum的例子來看，最好還是為合併案宣布後的股價劇烈波動，做好準備。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) investors are highly期待 (eager) for a merger with SpaceX (SPCX-US), expecting the latter to acquire Tesla in an all‑stock deal at a premium, which would boost Tesla’s share price. However, Barron’s argues that before Tesla investors try to cash in on such a deal, they should first understand what happened to the stock prices of Marvell (MRVL-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US).

On Monday (the 2nd), Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all‑stock transaction, valuing Lumentum at $1,132 per share, a 24% premium to its October 28 closing price. Under the terms, Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 shares of Marvell for each Lumentum share they own.
But market reaction was muted after the announcement; Lumentum plunged nearly 19% on Monday, closing at $684.40 per share, while Marvell’s stock fell about 13% to $171.41.

In other words, Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum at $1,132 per share, yet by Monday’s close Lumentum was trading roughly 40% below that price. Marvell’s own share price was also down more than 30% from its October 28 close of $251.65.

The market clearly dislikes the deal. The combined market value of the two companies fell from about $330 billion on October 28 to $230 billion on Monday. The transaction, intended to combine high‑end chips for AI data‑center expansion with high‑end optical‑connector manufacturing, has erased roughly $100 billion of market value for the two firms.

NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang hinted in June that Marvell could be worth $1 trillion. Based on Monday’s closing price, Marvell’s market cap is about $150 billion, and its share price is down nearly 50% from the 52‑week high of $329.88 set in June.

Barron notes that when investors are optimistic about an acquisition, the combined company’s total value usually rises, creating a “one‑plus‑one‑greater‑than‑two” effect. When enterprise value climbs, investors can compare the expected synergies with the increase in market cap to judge whether the market’s reaction is reasonable.
In this deal, the two firms expected to generate $1 billion of synergies, but given the post‑merger market‑cap loss of $100 billion, the synergy multiple is negative 100‑times.

Investors oppose the deal for several reasons, including a lengthy regulatory review, the unusual pairing of a manufacturer (Lumentum) with a chip designer (Marvell), and concerns about equity dilution.
An all‑stock acquisition does not guarantee that the target’s share price will rise; after the deal closes, the target’s stock value will move in tandem with the acquirer’s price.
Investors currently expect SpaceX might offer a 20%‑30% premium for Tesla, pushing Tesla’s share price up to $500.

Barron believes that while SpaceX and Tesla investors are likely to strongly support Musk’s vision of a vertically integrated AI company, the Marvell‑Lumentum example suggests they should be prepared for sharp post‑announcement stock volatility.

items.title_en: Don't Rush AI Stocks After the U.S. Midterms! Wall Street Says Winners and Losers Must Be Clearly Identified
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉拿下國會兩院，美股周三上漲，部分AI概念股卻逆勢走低。華爾街分析師認為，選舉結果可能讓資料中心建設面臨更多限制，但算力需求並未消失；真正的變數在於建設速度、成本，以及放慢投資能否緩解市場對過度舉債的疑慮。
據《彭博》報導，那斯達克100指數上漲逾1%之際，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)及邁威爾(MRVL-US)等AI相關股票下跌。對分析師而言，這場選舉既帶來政策風險，也可能促使產業重新檢視支出紀律。

需求不會消失 資料中心恐蓋得更慢更貴

Truist投資長暨首席市場策略師Keith Lerner認為，選舉增加了資料中心發展路徑與速度的不確定性，但龐大算力需求仍會支持建設。業者可能面臨租稅優惠調整、地方反對，必須改變設廠地點，或接受更多限制與配套條件。
Wealthspire投資長Brad Long指出，德州選舉結果可能讓兩黨政治人物更加重視反資料中心民意。為了爭取連任，更多地方官員可能跟進，主張保護社區免受資料中心擴張影響。
他認為，市場需要消化的問題，不是資料中心會不會蓋，而是「蓋在哪裡、需要多久，以及得通過多少行政程序」。這些阻力可能延後資本支出，也推遲AI投資效益實現的時間。
RWA Wealth Partners投資長JP Powers則認為，市場擔憂可能有些過度，既有計畫未必受到太大影響。不過，業者若須增加地方回饋或因應更多法規，確實可能推升建設與營運成本。

擴張放慢未必全是壞事 有助緩解燒錢壓力

野村跨資產策略師Charlie McElligott提出另一種解讀：選舉若迫使美國資料中心建設放慢，可能緩和大型雲端業者不斷加碼資本支出的競賽，減輕市場對大量發債、股票籌資及自由現金流消耗的疑慮。
這也是選後市場可能偏向樂觀看待的原因之一。在此之前，投資人已開始擔心，AI投資規模持續膨脹，相關融資需求與回報前景是否能夠匹配。
盈透證券首席策略師Steve Sosnick表示，市場對業者支出過於激進、借款規模過大的擔憂有其道理。若建設速度降至較可控的程度，雖然對供應商不利，卻可能替產業帶來市場願意接受的財務紀律。
他也指出，資料中心建設已有龐大動能，牽涉大量就業，幾位州長當選及國會權力更替，不至於讓整體發展完全停下來。

年底行情添阻力 科技股反彈仍須挑選贏家

Miller Tabak首席市場策略師Matt Maley則提醒，AI產業面臨的阻力正在增加，可能讓市場更難出現期中選舉年份常見的年底漲勢。他預期，反對資料中心進駐社區的聲音，也將迅速成為2028年選舉議題。
加拿大皇家銀行資本市場美股策略主管Lori Calvasina認為，即使國會未採取明顯行動，州長選舉結果仍帶來政策風險，因為AI與資料中心已是部分激烈選戰的重要議題。她也對選舉能否成為市場風險解除的轉折點抱持保留態度。
摩根大通(JPM-US)全球市場情報主管Andrew Tyler則維持短線看多科技股的立場。他指出，德州候任州長Gina Hinojosa主張，在新規範建立前立即暫停資料中心建設，但實際影響仍有不同解讀。
一種可能是既有工程與許可繼續推進，新計畫轉往其他州；另一種則是整體建設放慢，帶動資本支出下降。Tyler表示，不會放棄科技股交易，仍看好戰術性反彈，但市場可能更加挑剔科技與AI領域的贏家及輸家。
paras_en: The Democrats won both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, and U.S. stocks rose on Wednesday, but some AI‑related stocks fell against the trend. Wall Street analysts say the election outcome could impose more constraints on data‑center construction, though the demand for compute power remains, and the real variables are construction speed, cost, and whether slower investment can ease market concerns about excessive borrowing.

According to Bloomberg, while the Nasdaq‑100 index rose more than 1%, AI‑related shares such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Marvell (MRVL‑US) slipped. Analysts see the election bringing policy risk and prompting the industry to re‑examine spending discipline.

Demand Won’t Disappear; Data Centers May Be Built More Slowly and Expensively

Truist’s chief investment officer and head of market strategy Keith Lerner says the election adds uncertainty to the path and pace of data‑center development, but the massive compute demand will still drive construction. Companies may face changes to tax incentives, local opposition, the need to relocate sites, or tighter restrictions and conditions.

Wealthspire’s chief investment officer Brad Long notes that the Texas election results could make politicians from both parties pay more attention to anti‑data‑center sentiment. To secure re‑election, more local officials may follow suit, advocating to protect communities from data‑center expansion.

He argues the market’s issue to digest isn’t whether data centers will be built, but “where they’ll be built, how long it will take, and how many regulatory hurdles must be cleared.” Those frictions could delay capital spending and push back the timeline for realizing AI investment returns.

RWA Wealth Partners’ chief investment officer JP Powers thinks market worries may be overstated and existing projects are unlikely to be heavily impacted. Still, if developers have to increase local contributions or comply with more regulations, construction and operating costs could rise.

A slower expansion isn’t necessarily all bad; it could ease cash‑burn pressure

Nomura cross‑asset strategist Charlie McElligott offers another view: if the election forces U.S. data‑center builds to slow down, it may temper the race among large cloud providers to pour capital into capacity, reducing market concerns about massive debt issuance, equity financing and free‑cash‑flow consumption.

That is one reason why post‑election markets might remain relatively optimistic. Previously, investors had begun worrying that the scale of AI investment was inflating faster than financing could match the expected returns.

Interactive Brokers’ chief strategist Steve Sosnick says concerns about overly aggressive spending and large borrowing by providers are justified. If construction pace becomes more manageable, it may hurt suppliers but could impose financial discipline that the market is willing to accept.

He also points out that data‑center construction already has strong momentum and involves many jobs, and the election of several governors and the shift in congressional power are unlikely to halt overall development entirely.

Year‑end rally faces headwinds; tech stocks need careful winner selection

Miller Tabak chief market strategist Matt Maley warns that growing obstacles for the AI sector could make it harder for the typical year‑end rally seen in midterm election years. He expects anti‑data‑center sentiment to quickly become a campaign issue in the 2028 election.

RBC Capital Markets U.S. equities strategist Lori Calvasina says that even without clear congressional action, the governor races still create policy risk because AI and data centers have become key issues in heated contests. She remains cautious about whether the election can serve as a turning point that removes market risk.

JPMorgan (JPM‑US) global markets intelligence head Andrew Tyler maintains a short‑term bullish stance on tech stocks. He notes that Texas gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa proposes pausing data‑center construction before new rules are set, but the actual impact is open to interpretation.

One scenario is that existing projects and permits continue while new plans shift to other states; another is an overall slowdown that curtails capital spending. Tyler says he won’t abandon tech‑stock trading, still expects tactical rebounds, but markets may become pickier about winners and losers in the tech and AI space.

items.title: 敗選也傷荷包！川普媒體股價跌破歷史低點 迷因幣重挫逾10%
items.title_en: Election Loss Also Hits Wallets! Trump Media Stock Falls Below Historic Low, Meme Coin Plummets Over 10%
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝、拿下國會兩院後，與總統川普相關的資產遭到拋售。川普媒體與科技集團(DJT-US)周三(4日)股價觸及歷史新低，川普迷因幣也重挫，反映投資人擔心，川普家族的商業利益將面臨新一輪國會監督。
據外媒報導，旗下擁有社群平台Truth Social的川普媒體，股價盤中一度跌至5.03美元，創歷史新低。根據CoinMarketCap數據，川普在第二任就職前幾天推出的迷因幣$TRUMP，過去24小時跌幅超過10%。
這兩項資產的交易都高度受到散戶投機活動影響，同步下跌顯示，市場正重新評估選舉結果對川普相關企業的衝擊。過去數月，民主黨已多次表態，若取得任一國會議院控制權，將尋求調查川普及其家族的商業利益，讓與第一家庭有關的企業都可能成為調查對象。
預料將出任眾議院監督委員會主席的加州民主黨眾議員Robert Garcia，周二晚間隨著選舉結果陸續揭曉，在社群媒體發文寫道：「找好律師吧。」
相關事業是川普家族財富的重要來源。根據彭博億萬富豪指數，川普透過由長子小唐納控制的信託，持有價值約6億美元的川普媒體股份；迷因幣事業則占其財富約8,300萬美元。
川普第二任期陸續拓展新事業，成為其任內備受關注的現象。他在任期間從加密貨幣及冠有其名的商業活動獲利，打破美國總統數十年來的慣例，也引發左派對利益衝突的批評。
今年稍早，《紐約時報》詢問川普第二任期的利益衝突問題時，他回答：「我發現根本沒人在乎。」白宮則持續強調，總統的商業活動並不存在利益衝突。
然而，選前民調顯示，政府貪腐是選民高度關切的議題。福斯新聞民調發現，60%選民對政府貪腐極度擔憂；蓋洛普調查則顯示，89%受訪者認為美國政府貪腐普遍，反映民眾對政府貪腐的觀感達到20年來最嚴重的程度。
paras_en: After the Democrats’ sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections and gaining control of both chambers of Congress, assets tied to former President Trump have been sold off. Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT‑US) saw its share price hit a historic low on Wednesday (the 4th), and the Trump meme coin also tumbled, reflecting investors’ worries that the Trump family’s business interests will face a new round of congressional oversight.

According to foreign media reports, Trump Media, which owns the social platform Truth Social, saw its stock dip intraday to $5.03, a record low. CoinMarketCap data shows that the $TRUMP meme coin, launched just days before Trump’s second inauguration, fell more than 10% in the past 24 hours.

Both assets are heavily influenced by retail speculation, and their simultaneous decline indicates the market is re‑evaluating the election’s impact on Trump‑related companies. In recent months the Democrats have repeatedly said that if they gain control of either house of Congress they will seek investigations into Trump and his family’s business interests, putting any enterprise linked to the First Family at risk of scrutiny.

California Democrat Representative Robert Garcia, who is expected to become chair of the House Oversight Committee, posted on social media on Tuesday night as election results continued to roll in, writing: “Find a good lawyer.”

These businesses are a major source of the Trump family’s wealth. Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index estimates that Trump, through a trust controlled by his eldest son Donald Jr., holds about $600 million worth of Trump Media shares; the meme‑coin venture accounts for roughly $83 million of his fortune.

Trump’s second term has seen a steady rollout of new ventures, becoming a hallmark of his presidency. He profited from cryptocurrency and other commercial activities bearing his name, breaking decades‑long norms for U.S. presidents and drawing left‑wing criticism over potential conflicts of interest.

Earlier this year, when The New York Times asked about conflicts of interest in his second term, Trump replied, “I find that nobody really cares.” The White House continues to stress that the president’s business activities do not constitute a conflict of interest.

However, pre‑election polls show that government corruption is a top concern for voters. A Fox News poll found that 60% of respondents are extremely worried about government corruption; a Gallup survey showed 89% believe corruption is widespread in the U.S. government, marking the highest level of public concern in two decades.

items.title: AI股選後能翻身？小摩看科技股反彈 加碼先看四大訊號
items.title_en: Can AI Stocks Recover After the Election? JPMorgan Sees Tech Bounce, Looks for Four Key Signals Before Adding More
paras: 美國期中選舉結果出爐後，美股周三(4日)扭轉稍早跌勢走高。摩根大通(JPM-US)交易部門認為，近期遭到拋售的科技股有望迎來短線反彈，市場漲勢也可能從少數大型權值股，擴散至更多產業。不過，團隊尚未全面看多AI交易，配置上仍較偏重景氣循環股。
由Andrew Tyler領軍的美國市場情報團隊在周三報告中表示：「我們不會放棄科技股交易，並會布局戰術性反彈。」團隊建議採取槓鈴式策略，同時配置科技股與景氣循環股，但給予後者較高權重。

科技股有望反彈 AI加碼仍待四大訊號

民主黨取得國會控制權後，投資人持續評估科技業面臨的政策變化，尤其是AI基礎建設支出前景。德州州長當選人Gina Hinojosa主張，在建立更多規範前立即暫停新資料中心建設，一度引發隔夜賣壓。不過，以科技股為主的那斯達克100指數周三轉而上漲1.8%。
摩根大通交易部門認為，市場對德州政策可能轉向的疑慮或許過大，因為資料中心仍可選擇在其他州興建，新規也不代表所有建設都將完全停擺。
儘管看好短線反彈，團隊並未對AI交易全面亮綠燈。投資人在重新增加曝險前，仍希望看到幾項訊號，包括市場持倉充分出清、大型雲端業者確認資本支出計畫、半導體與記憶體企業交出正面財報，以及資本市場活動改善。
這也意味著，科技股回升不等於AI相關企業將全面受惠。隨著市場更加重視投資回報與資金來源，投資人將更仔細區分AI產業的贏家與輸家。
巴克萊同日上午也提醒，選舉結果本身不足以替美股掃除年底上漲的障礙，顯示華爾街對選後行情能否持續仍有不同看法。
科技業之外，摩根大通交易部門也關注，民主黨是否會推動結束與伊朗的衝突。團隊指出，新一屆國會明年1月就任後，議員可能採取撤回資金支持或要求撤軍等措施，針對未獲國會授權、持續逾90天的軍事衝突施壓。該行認為，市場似乎正逐漸反映達成協議的可能性。

選後漲勢可望擴散 偏好消費與金融股

歷史表現則為團隊的樂觀看法提供另一項依據。報告引述摩根大通Craig Cohen的統計指出，自1950年以來，每次期中選舉隔年，標普500指數均上漲，平均漲幅約15%。
若觀察選舉後不同期間，標普500過去在三個月內平均上漲5.4%，六個月內上漲11.4%，九個月內上漲12.5%。這些歷史數據為選後行情提供參考，但並非未來報酬的保證。
整體而言，團隊預期漲勢將擴及更多產業，但能源股的上漲空間相對有限，科技股下跌空間則可能縮小。在景氣循環類股中，團隊偏好消費與金融股，尤其是在殖利率曲線持續變陡的情境下。
paras_en: After the U.S. midterm election results were announced, U.S. equities reversed earlier losses and rose on Wednesday, the 4th. JPMorgan (JPM-US) trading desk believes that tech stocks recently sold off could see a short‑term rebound, and the market rally may spread from a few large‑cap names to more sectors. However, the team is not fully bullish on AI trades yet and still leans toward cyclical stocks in its allocation.

The U.S. market intelligence team led by Andrew Tyler said in its Wednesday report: “We are not abandoning tech trading and will position for a tactical rebound.” The team recommends a barbell approach, allocating to both tech and cyclical stocks but giving the latter a higher weight.

Tech stocks could bounce, but AI upgrades still await four key signals. After Democrats took control of Congress, investors continue to assess policy changes facing the tech sector, especially the outlook for AI infrastructure spending. Texas governor‑elect Gina Hinojosa has advocated pausing new data‑center construction until more regulations are in place, which sparked overnight selling pressure. Nonetheless, the Nasdaq‑100, which is tech‑heavy, rose 1.8% on Wednesday.

JPMorgan’s trading desk thinks market concerns about a possible shift in Texas policy may be overstated, since data centers can be built in other states and new rules do not mean all projects will be halted.

While optimistic about a short‑term bounce, the team has not given a full green light to AI trades. Before investors increase exposure again, they want to see several signals: market positions fully cleared, major cloud providers confirming cap‑ex plans, semiconductor and memory companies delivering positive earnings, and an improvement in capital‑market activity.

This also means a tech‑stock rally does not automatically translate into a broad benefit for AI‑related firms. As the market focuses more on returns and funding sources, investors will scrutinize winners and losers within the AI industry more closely.

Barclays also warned that the election outcome alone is insufficient to clear the path for year‑end equity gains, indicating that Wall Street remains divided on whether post‑election momentum can be sustained.

Beyond tech, JPMorgan’s trading desk is watching whether Democrats will push to end the conflict with Iran. The team notes that after the new Congress takes office in January, lawmakers may move to withdraw funding or demand troop withdrawals, pressuring a war that has lasted over 90 days without congressional authorization. The bank believes the market is gradually pricing in the possibility of a deal.

Historical performance provides another basis for the team’s optimism. The report cites JPMorgan’s Craig Cohen, who notes that since 1950, the S&P 500 has risen in the year following every midterm election, with an average gain of about 15%.

Looking at different post‑election horizons, the S&P 500 has historically risen an average of 5.4% in the first three months, 11.4% in six months and 12.5% in nine months. These figures offer context for post‑election market behavior but are not guarantees of future returns.

Overall, the team expects the rally to spread to more sectors, though energy stocks have limited upside and the downside potential for tech may shrink. Within cyclical stocks, the team favors consumer and financial stocks, especially as the yield curve continues to steepen.

items.title: SpaceX攜手高通建美國5G網路Starlink Mobile明年起部署基地台
items.title_en: SpaceX Teams with Qualcomm to Build U.S. 5G Starlink Mobile Network, Deploy Base Stations Starting Next Year
paras: 2026年11月05日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 高通(QCOM-US)11月4日宣布，SpaceX將採用旗下Dragonwing行動通訊基礎設施平台，打造Starlink Mobile的美國全國性地面5G網路。依雙方多年合作協議，部署預計2027年啟動，並在合作期間布建數萬座基地台。
Starlink希望將衛星與地面網路整合，改善用戶在室內及移動途中的連線體驗。此次合作由高通提供基地台射頻、基頻處理平台及底層通訊軟體，協助SpaceX加快基地台架構開發，將衛星連網服務延伸至地面行動通訊網路。
基地台將採用具備64組發射與接收路徑的大規模多輸入多輸出技術(Massive MIMO)。高通表示，這項設計可提高涵蓋範圍、容量及頻譜使用效率，搭配低功耗處理，改善大規模建網的能源效率。本次部署以5G為主，雙方也將未來支援AI原生6G列為發展方向，公告未揭露合約金額。

paras_en: November 5, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Qualcomm (QCOM-US) announced on November 4 that SpaceX will use its Dragonwing mobile communications infrastructure platform to create a nationwide ground 5G network for Starlink Mobile in the United States. Under a multi‑year cooperation agreement, deployment is slated to begin in 2027, with tens of thousands of base stations to be built during the partnership period.

Starlink aims to integrate satellite and terrestrial networks to improve indoor and on‑the‑move connectivity for users. In this collaboration, Qualcomm will provide the base‑station radio‑frequency hardware, baseband processing platform, and underlying communications software to help SpaceX accelerate base‑station architecture development and extend satellite connectivity services to terrestrial mobile networks.

The base stations will employ massive MIMO technology with 64 transmit and receive paths. Qualcomm said this design enhances coverage, capacity and spectrum efficiency, and, combined with low‑power processing, improves the energy efficiency of large‑scale network roll‑outs. The deployment will focus on 5G, while both parties also plan to support AI‑native 6G in the future; the contract value was not disclosed.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉川普想逼降息更難了！參院翻藍替Fed築起防線
items.title_en: Trump Faces Greater Difficulty in Lowering Interest Rates as Democrats Take Senate Control
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉奪回參議院控制權，為聯準會(Fed)抵禦白宮政治壓力增添一道防線。由於Fed理事任命須經參議院同意，川普透過安插親信重塑決策團隊、推動降息的空間將大幅縮小，也可能讓Fed主席華許有更大自主性，以較高利率對抗通膨。
不過，部分觀察人士提醒，人事任命受到制衡，並不代表政治干預風險消失。白宮仍可能透過解職威脅或司法調查向現任官員施壓，Fed獨立性面臨的考驗尚未結束。

民主黨掌握人事審查 華倫可望接掌銀行委員會

截至周三清晨，民主黨已拿下至少54席參議員，僅阿拉斯加州與密西西比州結果未定。目前民主黨陣營則有47席，包含兩名與其共同運作的獨立派議員。
待新一屆國會就任後，麻州參議員華倫可望接掌參議院銀行委員會，掌握Fed人事案的重要審查關卡。外界預期，她將阻擋被認為過度順從白宮壓力的提名人選。華倫雖長期要求加強Fed監督，尤其是華爾街監管責任，但也支持利率決策免受政治干預。
曾共同撰寫Fed獨立性歷史著作的Potomac River Capital投資經理Mark Spindel表示，民主黨控制參議院，將讓Fed獲得更強力的保護，抵禦總統施壓。
保德信投資管理全球首席經濟學家Daleep Singh則指出，選舉削弱川普對國會、全國政治及Fed的影響力，而選民又對生活成本上漲感到憤怒，這讓Fed更有條件採取抗通膨行動。

理事會目前沒有空缺 川普改組空間受限

川普過去近兩年持續要求大幅降息，也試圖擴大對Fed的控制，包括支持司法部調查前主席鮑爾，以及推動撤換理事庫克。
針對庫克，川普已下令舉行白宮聽證會，檢視尚未獲證實的房貸詐欺指控。白宮高層上周表示，聽證會可能於12月舉行。
不過，即使共和黨掌控參議院，白宮施壓也曾遭遇阻力。共和黨參議員提里斯先前一度擋下華許出任Fed主席的提名程序，直到司法部撤回對鮑爾的調查。
目前Fed七人理事會並無空缺。鮑爾在5月主席任期屆滿後選擇留任理事，其理事任期直到2028年1月，未讓川普因此取得新的任命機會。
去年8月理事庫格勒突然辭職時，川普政府曾迅速與參議院共和黨人合作，讓白宮經濟顧問米蘭接任。米蘭參與的六次利率會議均投下異議票，主張更大幅度降息，直到今年5月由華許接替理事席次。
民主黨掌握參議院後，即使未來出現空缺，白宮也難以同樣方式快速安插屬意人選。

阻擋親信不等於杜絕干預 解職與司法施壓仍是風險

若理事會因法院裁決或其他原因出現空缺，民主黨主導的銀行委員會可拒絕推進接任人選的審查，寧可讓席次懸缺，也不讓川普盟友入主。
然而，部分Fed觀察人士認為，參議院翻盤提供的保護仍有限。民主黨無法完全阻止白宮以解職威脅等手段影響現任決策官員；若政府成功撤換不喜歡的官員，即使沒有補上新人，也可能改變Fed內部的力量平衡。
依法律，總統只能「因故」解除Fed理事職務。法律學者長期將此解讀為涉及嚴重不當行為或失職，而非單純政策分歧。
保守派智庫美國企業研究所經濟政策研究主任Michael Strain認為，民主黨掌控參議院只能小幅降低Fed獨立性面臨的威脅，尚不足以構成根本轉變。他警告，更大的風險是將刑事司法體系當成工具，藉此影響貨幣政策決策。
paras_en: The Democratic Party’s takeover of the U.S. Senate in the midterm elections adds a new layer of protection for the Federal Reserve (Fed) against White House political pressure. Because Fed board appointments require Senate confirmation, Trump’s ability to reshape the decision‑making team and push for rate cuts will be significantly curtailed, potentially giving Fed Chair Jerome Powell more autonomy to combat inflation with higher rates.

However, some observers warn that checks on personnel appointments do not eliminate the risk of political interference. The White House could still exert pressure on current officials through dismissal threats or judicial investigations, and the Fed’s independence remains under test.
With the Democrats holding at least 54 seats, the Senate is now under their control, while the Republican bloc sits with 47 seats, including two independents who caucus with them.

Once the new Congress convenes, Massachusetts Senator Patty Murray is expected to chair the Senate Banking Committee, a key gatekeeper for Fed personnel decisions. She is anticipated to block nominees perceived as overly compliant with White House pressure. Murray has long advocated stronger Fed oversight, especially over Wall Street regulation, while supporting rate decisions free from political influence.

Mark Spindel, a portfolio manager at Potomac River Capital who co‑authored a book on Fed independence, said that Democratic control of the Senate will provide stronger protection for the Fed against presidential pressure.

Daleep Singh, chief economist at Prudential Investment Management Global, noted that the election weakened Trump’s influence over Congress, national politics, and the Fed, and that voters’ anger over rising living costs gives the Fed better conditions to pursue anti‑inflationary action.

The Fed’s board currently has no vacancies, limiting Trump’s ability to reorganize the institution. Trump has repeatedly sought large rate cuts over the past two years and tried to expand his control of the Fed, including supporting a DOJ investigation into former Chair Powell and pushing for the removal of Board member Lael Brainard.
Regarding Brainard, Trump has ordered a White House hearing to examine unverified mortgage fraud allegations. White House officials said the hearing could take place in December.

Even when Republicans controlled the Senate, White House pressure faced resistance. Republican Senator Tim Scott once blocked Powell’s nomination as Fed Chair until the DOJ withdrew its investigation into Powell.

The Fed’s seven‑member board currently has no vacancies. Powell chose to remain on the board after his chair term ended in May, with a term that runs until January 2028, preventing Trump from gaining a new appointment opportunity.

When Board member Patrick Harker suddenly resigned in August last year, the Trump administration quickly worked with Senate Republicans to have White House economic adviser Michael M. M. replace him. M. M. cast dissenting votes at six rate meetings, advocating larger cuts, until Powell replaced the seat in May this year.
Even if a vacancy arises in the future, the Democrats’ control of the Senate makes it difficult for the White House to quickly insert a compliant candidate.

Blocking loyalists does not eliminate interference; dismissal and judicial pressure remain risks. If a vacancy arises due to a court ruling or other reasons, the Democrat‑led Banking Committee could refuse to advance a nominee, preferring to leave the seat vacant rather than allow a Trump ally to fill it.

Some Fed observers believe the Senate flip still offers limited protection. Democrats cannot fully prevent the White House from using dismissal threats to influence current officials; if the government successfully removes an unwanted official, even without appointing a replacement, it could shift the Fed’s internal power balance.
By law, the president can only remove a Fed board member for “cause.” Legal scholars have long interpreted this as requiring serious misconduct or dereliction of duty, not mere policy disagreement.

Michael Strain, director of economic policy research at the conservative think‑tank American Enterprise Institute, argues that Democratic control of the Senate only slightly reduces the threat to Fed independence and is not a fundamental shift. He warns that the greater risk is using the criminal justice system as a tool to influence monetary policy decisions.

items.title: 漲價還沒完？美國10月服務業成本還沒全轉嫁 Fed抗通膨難鬆手
items.title_en: Price Hikes Not Over? US October Service‑Sector Costs Still Not Fully Passed On, Fed’s Fight Against Inflation Remains Tough
paras: 美國10月服務業擴張速度降至三個月來最慢，但企業投入成本仍居高不下，關稅與中東戰爭造成的供應鏈壓力也尚未消退。最新數據顯示，美國經濟進入第四季仍具韌性，卻同時面臨需求降溫與通膨難退的考驗，使聯準會(Fed)對抗物價壓力的任務更加棘手。
美國供應管理協會(ISM)周三(4日)公布，10月非製造業指數由9月的54.9降至54.5，低於《路透》調查預估的54.8。指數高於50代表擴張，顯示占美國經濟活動逾三分之二的服務業仍持續成長。

美國10月ISM非製造業指數細項：(50為榮枯線)


商業活動生產指數報53.8，前值56.5
新訂單指數報55.9，前值59.8     
僱傭指數報51.4，前值50.1
供應商交貨指數報56.7，前值52.8
存貨指數報55.4，前值57.8
價格指數報73.0，前值74.0
未完成訂單指數報58.0，前值56.6
新出口訂單指數報55.2，前值46.9
進口指數報54.2，前值52.9
庫存景氣指數報52.1，前值51.7




服務業擴張放緩 新訂單降溫但聘僱改善

ISM非製造業調查中的新訂單指數由59.8降至55.9，創四個月新低，但仍處於擴張區間；未完成訂單指數則升至2022年以來最高，顯示企業仍有大量訂單待消化。10月共有15個服務業產業回報成長，包括運輸倉儲、資訊與娛樂業，營建及醫療保健業則呈現萎縮。
企業在需求與成本之間審慎調整人力，就業指數仍由50.1升至51.4，創2月以來最高，反映聘僱活動有所改善。
另一份標普全球調查也顯示成長降溫。10月美國服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)由9月的58.8降至56.1，低於初值57.9；綜合PMI則由58.4降至55.9，同樣創三個月新低。
標普全球市場財智首席商業經濟學家Chris Williamson表示，美國經濟第四季開局仍強，科技業持續引領成長，面向消費者的產業及金融服務也有穩健表現。不過，新訂單增幅放緩，服務業企業信心明顯下降，反映對負擔能力、利率及政治環境的不安。

成本壓力尚未完全轉嫁 Fed抗通膨仍有考驗

ISM非製造業投入價格指數雖由74降至73，仍是2022年中以來第二高。供應商交貨指數則由53.2升至56.7，創4月以來最高；該指數高於50代表交貨放慢，目前已連續23個月處於此區間。
ISM服務業調查委員會主席Steve Miller指出，關稅與燃料成本仍是受訪企業最常提及的供應鏈問題，許多業者尚未感受到成本上升的全部影響，或尚未將其轉嫁給客戶。若油價與關稅壓力無法緩解，後續仍可能出現更多漲價壓力。
標普全球調查也發現，服務業售價以過去四年來最快的速度之一上漲，加上製造業商品售價跳升，Williamson警告，未來幾個月通膨可能進一步偏離Fed目標。
高物價也正侵蝕家庭購買力。美國9月扣除通膨與稅負後的可支配所得下滑，儲蓄率降至四年低點3.8%，使經濟學家預期，消費支出在連續兩季強勁成長後可能放緩。
Fed上周維持政策利率區間於3.75%至4%，並重申通膨仍偏高。《路透》報導指出，經濟學家預期通膨高於2%目標的情況將延續至2027年，並預估Fed可能在12月升息。
paras_en: US service‑sector expansion in October slowed to its weakest pace in three months, yet corporate cost inputs remain high and supply‑chain pressures from tariffs and the Middle‑East war have not eased. The latest data show that the US economy remains resilient heading into the fourth quarter, but it also faces cooling demand and stubborn inflation, making the Fed’s task of combating price pressures even more challenging.

The Institute for Supply Management (ISM) released its October non‑manufacturing index on Wednesday (the 4th), showing a decline to 54.5 from September’s 54.9, below Reuters’ forecast of 54.8. An index above 50 signals expansion, indicating that the service sector – which accounts for more than two‑thirds of US economic activity – continues to grow.

October ISM non‑manufacturing sub‑indices (50 is the break‑even line):
- Business Activity: 53.8 (prev. 56.5)
- New Orders: 55.9 (prev. 59.8)
- Employment: 51.4 (prev. 50.1)
- Supplier Deliveries: 56.7 (prev. 52.8)
- Inventories: 55.4 (prev. 57.8)
- Prices: 73.0 (prev. 74.0)
- Backlog of Orders: 58.0 (prev. 56.6)
- New Export Orders: 55.2 (prev. 46.9)
- Imports: 54.2 (prev. 52.9)
- Inventory‑to‑Sales Ratio: 52.1 (prev. 51.7)

Service‑sector expansion is slowing, new orders are cooling but hiring is improving.

Companies are cautiously adjusting labor in response to demand and cost pressures, pushing the employment index up to 51.4 from 50.1 – the highest since February – reflecting an improvement in hiring activity.

Another S&P Global survey also shows a slowdown in growth. The US services PMI fell to 56.1 in October from 58.8 in September, below the preliminary reading of 57.9; the composite PMI dropped from 58.4 to 55.9, also a three‑month low.

S&P Global Market Intelligence chief economist Chris Williamson said the US economy started Q4 strong, with technology continuing to lead growth and consumer‑facing industries and financial services showing solid performance. However, the pace of new orders is slowing and service‑sector confidence is clearly weakening, reflecting concerns about affordability, interest rates and the political environment.

Cost pressures have not been fully passed on, keeping the Fed’s anti‑inflation fight challenging. The ISM non‑manufacturing price index fell to 73 from 74, still the second‑highest level since mid‑2022. The supplier‑delivery index rose to 56.7 from 53.2, the highest since April; a reading above 50 indicates slower deliveries, and the index has stayed in that zone for 23 consecutive months.

ISM services survey chair Steve Miller noted that tariffs and fuel costs remain the most frequently cited supply‑chain issues among respondents, and many firms have not yet felt the full impact of rising costs nor passed them on to customers. If oil‑price and tariff pressures do not ease, further price‑increase pressure could follow.

The S&P Global survey also found that service‑sector prices are rising at one of the fastest rates in the past four years, and manufacturing product prices are jumping sharply. Williamson warned that inflation could drift further away from the Fed’s target in the coming months.

High prices are also eroding household purchasing power. After stripping out inflation and taxes, US disposable income fell in September, and the savings rate dropped to a four‑year low of 3.8%, leading economists to expect consumer spending to slow after two consecutive quarters of strong growth.

The Fed kept its policy rate range at 3.75%‑4% last week and reiterated that inflation remains too high. Reuters reported that economists expect inflation to stay above the 2% target through 2027 and project a possible rate hike in December.

items.title: 美國期中選舉民主黨奪回參眾兩院，美股道瓊開盤大漲近2%，AI監管與關稅政策成市場焦點
items.title_en: Democrats Reclaim Both Chambers in U.S. Midterms, Dow Jumps Nearly 2% as AI Regulation and Tariff Policy Dominate Market Focus
paras: 2026年11月04日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國期中選舉結果出爐，民主黨成功奪回參議院與眾議院控制權，市場認為，川普(Donald Trump)未來兩年的政策推動將受到國會制衡，但也可能降低激進政策帶來的不確定性。加上川普釋出願與民主黨合作的訊號，帶動美股週三開盤走高，道瓊工業指數上漲近2%，標普500指數及那斯達克綜合指數漲幅均超過1%。
不過，科技硬體股卻與大盤走勢背離。根據11月4日盤中報價，戴爾科技Dell Technologies(DELL-US)重挫7.29%，邁威爾科技Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)下跌5.49%，希捷科技Seagate Technology(STX-US)下跌5.02%，康寧Corning(GLW-US)下跌3.83%。
半導體族群同樣承壓，英特爾Intel(INTC-US)下跌2.85%、艾司摩爾ASML(ASML-NL)下跌2.63%、美光科技Micron Technology(MU-US)下跌2.19%，台積電(2330-TW)下跌1.53%，輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)下跌0.73%。
市場對這次選舉結果的解讀，主要呈現兩個方向。
一方面，民主黨掌握國會兩院後，川普推動部分政策將面臨更多限制，投資人因此降低對政治不確定性的擔憂，帶動整體股市反彈。不過，關稅政策仍可能透過總統行政權限推進，市場並未完全排除新一輪貿易摩擦的風險。
另一方面，AI資料中心擴建可能面臨更大的政治阻力。此次期中選舉中，資料中心耗電量增加、電價上漲及地方居民反對大型開發案，已成為跨越兩黨的選舉議題。民主黨取得國會控制權後，市場開始擔憂AI基礎設施可能受到更嚴格的監管。
這也解釋了為何大盤上漲，伺服器、網通晶片及儲存設備族群卻出現較大跌幅。市場可能正重新評估AI資料中心的建設速度，以及大型雲端服務業者(Hyperscalers)龐大的資本支出能否如期轉化為設備訂單。
對供應鏈而言，真正的風險不一定是AI運算需求減弱，而是資料中心建設可能因電力不足、開發許可或地方監管而延後，使伺服器、晶片及儲存設備的採購時程受到影響。
此外，市場也開始預期，期中選舉結束後，川普政府可能重新推動貿易限制措施，包括依據《貿易法》第301條調查結果，對中國等貿易夥伴加徵關稅。先前美國政府曾考慮對中國商品加徵7.5%關稅，但因擔憂選前通膨壓力而暫緩公布。
因此，後續市場觀察重點將落在民主黨是否推動AI資料中心監管、川普是否重啟新一輪關稅，以及大型雲端服務業者能否維持原訂資本支出與設備採購計畫。

paras_en: On November 4, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The U.S. midterm election results are in, with Democrats successfully regaining control of both the Senate and the House. The market believes that Donald Trump’s policy agenda over the next two years will face congressional checks, potentially reducing the uncertainty associated with more radical policies. Coupled with Trump’s signal that he is willing to cooperate with Democrats, U.S. equities opened higher on Wednesday, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average up nearly 2% and both the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite gaining over 1%.

However, technology hardware stocks moved opposite to the broader market. According to intraday quotes on November 4, Dell Technologies (DELL-US) plunged 7.29%, Marvell Technology (MRVL-US) fell 5.49%, Seagate Technology (STX-US) dropped 5.02%, and Corning (GLW-US) slid 3.83%.

The semiconductor sector also felt pressure, with Intel (INTC-US) down 2.85%, ASML (ASML-NL) down 2.63%, Micron Technology (MU-US) down 2.19%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (2330-TW) down 1.53%, and NVIDIA (NVDA-US) down 0.73%.
Market interpretation of the election outcome falls into two main strands.

On one hand, with Democrats controlling both chambers, Trump’s ability to push certain policies will face greater constraints, leading investors to lower concerns about political uncertainty and sparking a broad market rebound. Nevertheless, tariff policy could still advance through presidential executive authority, and the market has not fully ruled out the risk of a new round of trade frictions.

On the other hand, the expansion of AI data centers may encounter heightened political resistance. In this midterm cycle, increased data‑center power consumption, rising electricity prices and local opposition to large‑scale projects have become bipartisan election issues. After Democrats take congressional control, the market began to worry that AI infrastructure could face stricter regulation.

This helps explain why the overall market rose while server, networking‑chip and storage‑equipment groups posted relatively larger declines. The market may be reassessing the pace of AI data‑center construction and whether the massive capital expenditures of hyperscalers can translate into equipment orders as expected.

For the supply chain, the real risk is not necessarily a weakening of AI compute demand, but the possibility that data‑center builds could be delayed by power shortages, permitting hurdles or local regulatory obstacles, which would push back procurement timelines for servers, chips and storage gear.

Moreover, the market is beginning to anticipate that after the midterms, the Trump administration could revive trade‑restriction measures, including imposing tariffs on China and other partners based on Section 301 investigations of the Trade Act. The U.S. government had previously considered a 7.5% tariff on Chinese goods but paused the announcement due to pre‑election inflation concerns.

Consequently, future market focus will center on whether Democrats push AI data‑center regulation, whether Trump restarts a new tariff round, and whether hyperscalers can stick to their planned capital spending and equipment procurement schedules.

items.title: 未必是美夢！邁威爾收購Lumentum市值蒸發千億美元 巴隆點出特斯拉與SpaceX投資人也該警惕
items.title_en: Not Necessarily a Dream! Marvell’s $100 Billion Market‑Cap Loss After Acquiring Lumentum, Barron Warns Tesla and SpaceX Investors to Be Cautious
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)投資人無不高度期待能與SpaceX(SPCX-US)合併，預期後者將以全股票交易方式溢價收購，進而推升特斯拉股價。但巴隆周刊(Barron’s)認為，在特斯拉投資人準備兌現這筆交易帶來的收益之前，應該先了解邁威爾(Marvell)(MRVL-US)與Lumentum(LITE-US)兩家公司股價發生的事。
邁威爾周一(2日)同意以全股票交易方式收購Lumentum，對後者的估值為每股1,132美元，較10月28日收盤價溢價24%。按照目前交易條件，Lumentum股東每持有1股Lumentum股票，將取得4.5股邁威爾股票。
但消息公布後，當天市場反應冷淡，Lumentum周一重挫近19%，收在每股684.40美元，邁威爾股價也下跌近13%，收在每股171.41美元。
換句話說，邁威爾同意以每股1,132美元收購Lumentum，但截至周一收盤，Lumentum股價已比這個價格低了約40%。邁威爾股價也較10月28日收盤價251.65美元下跌逾30%。
市場顯然非常不看好這筆交易。兩家公司合併後的總市值，已從10月28日約3,300億美元，降至周一的2,300億美元。這筆交易意在整合人工智慧(AI)資料中心擴建潮核心的高階晶片與高階光學連接器製造業務，卻讓兩家公司合計蒸發約1,000億美元市值。
輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳6月曾暗示，邁威爾的價值可能達到1兆美元。邁威爾市值以周一收盤價計算約為1,500億美元，股價則比6月創下的52周高點329.88美元下跌近50%。
巴隆指出，通常當投資人看好一筆併購交易時，合併後公司的總價值也會提高，發揮一加一大於二的效果。而當企業價值上升時，投資人可以檢視交易預期創造的綜效金額，並與市值增幅比較，以判斷市場反應是否合理。
這筆交易中，兩家公司預料將創造10億美元綜效，但以合併後市值變化(蒸發1000億美元)計算，綜效倍數為負100倍。
投資人反對這筆交易有幾個原因，包括漫長的監管審查、讓製造商(Lumentum)與晶片設計商(邁威爾)合併的作法不尋常，以及股權稀釋問題。
全股票併購交易並不保證被收購公司的股價會上漲，交易完成後，這些股票的價值將與收購方股價連動。
投資人目前對SpaceX和特斯拉的預期是，SpaceX可能提出20%或30%的溢價，把特斯拉股價推升至500美元
巴隆認為，雖然SpaceX與特斯拉的投資人很可能會大力支持馬斯克打造垂直整合AI公司的願景，但從邁威爾和Lumentum的例子來看，最好還是為合併案宣布後的股價劇烈波動，做好準備。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) investors are highly期待 (eager) for a merger with SpaceX (SPCX-US), expecting the latter to acquire Tesla in an all‑stock deal at a premium, which would boost Tesla’s share price. However, Barron’s argues that before Tesla investors try to cash in on such a deal, they should first understand what happened to the stock prices of Marvell (MRVL-US) and Lumentum (LITE-US).

On Monday (the 2nd), Marvell agreed to acquire Lumentum in an all‑stock transaction, valuing Lumentum at $1,132 per share, a 24% premium to its October 28 closing price. Under the terms, Lumentum shareholders will receive 4.5 shares of Marvell for each Lumentum share they own.
But market reaction was muted after the announcement; Lumentum plunged nearly 19% on Monday, closing at $684.40 per share, while Marvell’s stock fell about 13% to $171.41.

In other words, Marvell agreed to buy Lumentum at $1,132 per share, yet by Monday’s close Lumentum was trading roughly 40% below that price. Marvell’s own share price was also down more than 30% from its October 28 close of $251.65.

The market clearly dislikes the deal. The combined market value of the two companies fell from about $330 billion on October 28 to $230 billion on Monday. The transaction, intended to combine high‑end chips for AI data‑center expansion with high‑end optical‑connector manufacturing, has erased roughly $100 billion of market value for the two firms.

NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) CEO Jensen Huang hinted in June that Marvell could be worth $1 trillion. Based on Monday’s closing price, Marvell’s market cap is about $150 billion, and its share price is down nearly 50% from the 52‑week high of $329.88 set in June.

Barron notes that when investors are optimistic about an acquisition, the combined company’s total value usually rises, creating a “one‑plus‑one‑greater‑than‑two” effect. When enterprise value climbs, investors can compare the expected synergies with the increase in market cap to judge whether the market’s reaction is reasonable.
In this deal, the two firms expected to generate $1 billion of synergies, but given the post‑merger market‑cap loss of $100 billion, the synergy multiple is negative 100‑times.

Investors oppose the deal for several reasons, including a lengthy regulatory review, the unusual pairing of a manufacturer (Lumentum) with a chip designer (Marvell), and concerns about equity dilution.
An all‑stock acquisition does not guarantee that the target’s share price will rise; after the deal closes, the target’s stock value will move in tandem with the acquirer’s price.
Investors currently expect SpaceX might offer a 20%‑30% premium for Tesla, pushing Tesla’s share price up to $500.

Barron believes that while SpaceX and Tesla investors are likely to strongly support Musk’s vision of a vertically integrated AI company, the Marvell‑Lumentum example suggests they should be prepared for sharp post‑announcement stock volatility.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉選完也別急著追AI股！華爾街提醒贏家輸家要挑清楚
items.title_en: Don't Rush AI Stocks After the U.S. Midterms! Wall Street Says Winners and Losers Must Be Clearly Identified
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉拿下國會兩院，美股周三上漲，部分AI概念股卻逆勢走低。華爾街分析師認為，選舉結果可能讓資料中心建設面臨更多限制，但算力需求並未消失；真正的變數在於建設速度、成本，以及放慢投資能否緩解市場對過度舉債的疑慮。
據《彭博》報導，那斯達克100指數上漲逾1%之際，CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)及邁威爾(MRVL-US)等AI相關股票下跌。對分析師而言，這場選舉既帶來政策風險，也可能促使產業重新檢視支出紀律。

需求不會消失 資料中心恐蓋得更慢更貴

Truist投資長暨首席市場策略師Keith Lerner認為，選舉增加了資料中心發展路徑與速度的不確定性，但龐大算力需求仍會支持建設。業者可能面臨租稅優惠調整、地方反對，必須改變設廠地點，或接受更多限制與配套條件。
Wealthspire投資長Brad Long指出，德州選舉結果可能讓兩黨政治人物更加重視反資料中心民意。為了爭取連任，更多地方官員可能跟進，主張保護社區免受資料中心擴張影響。
他認為，市場需要消化的問題，不是資料中心會不會蓋，而是「蓋在哪裡、需要多久，以及得通過多少行政程序」。這些阻力可能延後資本支出，也推遲AI投資效益實現的時間。
RWA Wealth Partners投資長JP Powers則認為，市場擔憂可能有些過度，既有計畫未必受到太大影響。不過，業者若須增加地方回饋或因應更多法規，確實可能推升建設與營運成本。

擴張放慢未必全是壞事 有助緩解燒錢壓力

野村跨資產策略師Charlie McElligott提出另一種解讀：選舉若迫使美國資料中心建設放慢，可能緩和大型雲端業者不斷加碼資本支出的競賽，減輕市場對大量發債、股票籌資及自由現金流消耗的疑慮。
這也是選後市場可能偏向樂觀看待的原因之一。在此之前，投資人已開始擔心，AI投資規模持續膨脹，相關融資需求與回報前景是否能夠匹配。
盈透證券首席策略師Steve Sosnick表示，市場對業者支出過於激進、借款規模過大的擔憂有其道理。若建設速度降至較可控的程度，雖然對供應商不利，卻可能替產業帶來市場願意接受的財務紀律。
他也指出，資料中心建設已有龐大動能，牽涉大量就業，幾位州長當選及國會權力更替，不至於讓整體發展完全停下來。

年底行情添阻力 科技股反彈仍須挑選贏家

Miller Tabak首席市場策略師Matt Maley則提醒，AI產業面臨的阻力正在增加，可能讓市場更難出現期中選舉年份常見的年底漲勢。他預期，反對資料中心進駐社區的聲音，也將迅速成為2028年選舉議題。
加拿大皇家銀行資本市場美股策略主管Lori Calvasina認為，即使國會未採取明顯行動，州長選舉結果仍帶來政策風險，因為AI與資料中心已是部分激烈選戰的重要議題。她也對選舉能否成為市場風險解除的轉折點抱持保留態度。
摩根大通(JPM-US)全球市場情報主管Andrew Tyler則維持短線看多科技股的立場。他指出，德州候任州長Gina Hinojosa主張，在新規範建立前立即暫停資料中心建設，但實際影響仍有不同解讀。
一種可能是既有工程與許可繼續推進，新計畫轉往其他州；另一種則是整體建設放慢，帶動資本支出下降。Tyler表示，不會放棄科技股交易，仍看好戰術性反彈，但市場可能更加挑剔科技與AI領域的贏家及輸家。
paras_en: The Democrats won both chambers of Congress in the U.S. midterm elections, and U.S. stocks rose on Wednesday, but some AI‑related stocks fell against the trend. Wall Street analysts say the election outcome could impose more constraints on data‑center construction, though the demand for compute power remains, and the real variables are construction speed, cost, and whether slower investment can ease market concerns about excessive borrowing.

According to Bloomberg, while the Nasdaq‑100 index rose more than 1%, AI‑related shares such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Marvell (MRVL‑US) slipped. Analysts see the election bringing policy risk and prompting the industry to re‑examine spending discipline.

Demand Won’t Disappear; Data Centers May Be Built More Slowly and Expensively

Truist’s chief investment officer and head of market strategy Keith Lerner says the election adds uncertainty to the path and pace of data‑center development, but the massive compute demand will still drive construction. Companies may face changes to tax incentives, local opposition, the need to relocate sites, or tighter restrictions and conditions.

Wealthspire’s chief investment officer Brad Long notes that the Texas election results could make politicians from both parties pay more attention to anti‑data‑center sentiment. To secure re‑election, more local officials may follow suit, advocating to protect communities from data‑center expansion.

He argues the market’s issue to digest isn’t whether data centers will be built, but “where they’ll be built, how long it will take, and how many regulatory hurdles must be cleared.” Those frictions could delay capital spending and push back the timeline for realizing AI investment returns.

RWA Wealth Partners’ chief investment officer JP Powers thinks market worries may be overstated and existing projects are unlikely to be heavily impacted. Still, if developers have to increase local contributions or comply with more regulations, construction and operating costs could rise.

A slower expansion isn’t necessarily all bad; it could ease cash‑burn pressure

Nomura cross‑asset strategist Charlie McElligott offers another view: if the election forces U.S. data‑center builds to slow down, it may temper the race among large cloud providers to pour capital into capacity, reducing market concerns about massive debt issuance, equity financing and free‑cash‑flow consumption.

That is one reason why post‑election markets might remain relatively optimistic. Previously, investors had begun worrying that the scale of AI investment was inflating faster than financing could match the expected returns.

Interactive Brokers’ chief strategist Steve Sosnick says concerns about overly aggressive spending and large borrowing by providers are justified. If construction pace becomes more manageable, it may hurt suppliers but could impose financial discipline that the market is willing to accept.

He also points out that data‑center construction already has strong momentum and involves many jobs, and the election of several governors and the shift in congressional power are unlikely to halt overall development entirely.

Year‑end rally faces headwinds; tech stocks need careful winner selection

Miller Tabak chief market strategist Matt Maley warns that growing obstacles for the AI sector could make it harder for the typical year‑end rally seen in midterm election years. He expects anti‑data‑center sentiment to quickly become a campaign issue in the 2028 election.

RBC Capital Markets U.S. equities strategist Lori Calvasina says that even without clear congressional action, the governor races still create policy risk because AI and data centers have become key issues in heated contests. She remains cautious about whether the election can serve as a turning point that removes market risk.

JPMorgan (JPM‑US) global markets intelligence head Andrew Tyler maintains a short‑term bullish stance on tech stocks. He notes that Texas gubernatorial candidate Gina Hinojosa proposes pausing data‑center construction before new rules are set, but the actual impact is open to interpretation.

One scenario is that existing projects and permits continue while new plans shift to other states; another is an overall slowdown that curtails capital spending. Tyler says he won’t abandon tech‑stock trading, still expects tactical rebounds, but markets may become pickier about winners and losers in the tech and AI space.

items.title: 敗選也傷荷包！川普媒體股價跌破歷史低點 迷因幣重挫逾10%
items.title_en: Election Loss Also Hits Wallets! Trump Media Stock Falls Below Historic Low, Meme Coin Plummets Over 10%
paras: 民主黨在美國期中選舉大勝、拿下國會兩院後，與總統川普相關的資產遭到拋售。川普媒體與科技集團(DJT-US)周三(4日)股價觸及歷史新低，川普迷因幣也重挫，反映投資人擔心，川普家族的商業利益將面臨新一輪國會監督。
據外媒報導，旗下擁有社群平台Truth Social的川普媒體，股價盤中一度跌至5.03美元，創歷史新低。根據CoinMarketCap數據，川普在第二任就職前幾天推出的迷因幣$TRUMP，過去24小時跌幅超過10%。
這兩項資產的交易都高度受到散戶投機活動影響，同步下跌顯示，市場正重新評估選舉結果對川普相關企業的衝擊。過去數月，民主黨已多次表態，若取得任一國會議院控制權，將尋求調查川普及其家族的商業利益，讓與第一家庭有關的企業都可能成為調查對象。
預料將出任眾議院監督委員會主席的加州民主黨眾議員Robert Garcia，周二晚間隨著選舉結果陸續揭曉，在社群媒體發文寫道：「找好律師吧。」
相關事業是川普家族財富的重要來源。根據彭博億萬富豪指數，川普透過由長子小唐納控制的信託，持有價值約6億美元的川普媒體股份；迷因幣事業則占其財富約8,300萬美元。
川普第二任期陸續拓展新事業，成為其任內備受關注的現象。他在任期間從加密貨幣及冠有其名的商業活動獲利，打破美國總統數十年來的慣例，也引發左派對利益衝突的批評。
今年稍早，《紐約時報》詢問川普第二任期的利益衝突問題時，他回答：「我發現根本沒人在乎。」白宮則持續強調，總統的商業活動並不存在利益衝突。
然而，選前民調顯示，政府貪腐是選民高度關切的議題。福斯新聞民調發現，60%選民對政府貪腐極度擔憂；蓋洛普調查則顯示，89%受訪者認為美國政府貪腐普遍，反映民眾對政府貪腐的觀感達到20年來最嚴重的程度。
paras_en: After the Democrats’ sweeping victory in the U.S. midterm elections and gaining control of both chambers of Congress, assets tied to former President Trump have been sold off. Trump Media & Technology Group (DJT‑US) saw its share price hit a historic low on Wednesday (the 4th), and the Trump meme coin also tumbled, reflecting investors’ worries that the Trump family’s business interests will face a new round of congressional oversight.

According to foreign media reports, Trump Media, which owns the social platform Truth Social, saw its stock dip intraday to $5.03, a record low. CoinMarketCap data shows that the $TRUMP meme coin, launched just days before Trump’s second inauguration, fell more than 10% in the past 24 hours.

Both assets are heavily influenced by retail speculation, and their simultaneous decline indicates the market is re‑evaluating the election’s impact on Trump‑related companies. In recent months the Democrats have repeatedly said that if they gain control of either house of Congress they will seek investigations into Trump and his family’s business interests, putting any enterprise linked to the First Family at risk of scrutiny.

California Democrat Representative Robert Garcia, who is expected to become chair of the House Oversight Committee, posted on social media on Tuesday night as election results continued to roll in, writing: “Find a good lawyer.”

These businesses are a major source of the Trump family’s wealth. Bloomberg’s Billionaires Index estimates that Trump, through a trust controlled by his eldest son Donald Jr., holds about $600 million worth of Trump Media shares; the meme‑coin venture accounts for roughly $83 million of his fortune.

Trump’s second term has seen a steady rollout of new ventures, becoming a hallmark of his presidency. He profited from cryptocurrency and other commercial activities bearing his name, breaking decades‑long norms for U.S. presidents and drawing left‑wing criticism over potential conflicts of interest.

Earlier this year, when The New York Times asked about conflicts of interest in his second term, Trump replied, “I find that nobody really cares.” The White House continues to stress that the president’s business activities do not constitute a conflict of interest.

However, pre‑election polls show that government corruption is a top concern for voters. A Fox News poll found that 60% of respondents are extremely worried about government corruption; a Gallup survey showed 89% believe corruption is widespread in the U.S. government, marking the highest level of public concern in two decades.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉政治押注失靈？加密業關鍵選戰敗北 比特幣卻重返8萬美元
items.title_en: U.S. Midterm Election: Political Bets Falter? Crypto Industry Loses Key Races While Bitcoin Reclaims $80,000
paras: 加密貨幣產業在本屆美國期中選舉投入約2億美元，雖然支持的候選人大多勝出，卻在幾場重金布局的關鍵選戰失利。隨著民主黨拿下國會兩院，業界不僅面臨推動立法的阻力，也可能因與總統川普的密切關係，遭遇更嚴格的國會監督與調查。
最受矚目的挫敗出現在俄亥俄州。對加密貨幣抱持懷疑態度的民主黨人布朗(Sherrod Brown)以明顯優勢勝選，重返參議院，儘管加密貨幣政治行動委員會投入逾6,000萬美元試圖阻止他當選，仍未能奏效。

重金阻擋布朗失敗 關鍵選戰考驗政治影響力

俄亥俄州這場選戰是美國參議院史上最昂貴的選戰之一，也被視為檢驗加密貨幣產業政治影響力的重要指標。今年9月，參議院因民主黨反對，未能推進加密貨幣重要法案《Clarity Act》，已讓與川普關係日益密切的業界遭受打擊。
部分進步派民主黨候選人也在初選期間，成功以對手與加密貨幣產業的關係作為攻擊主軸。道明考恩分析師Jaret Seiberg在周二報告中表示，這些發展正使加密貨幣面對的政治環境惡化，也讓部分遊說人士質疑業界是否押對候選人。
不過，業界並非全面失利。主要超級政治行動委員會Fairshake及其關聯組織，投入至少1,350萬美元阻擋內布拉斯加州獨立參議員候選人Dan Osborn，最終由曾支持《Clarity Act》的共和黨現任參議員Pete Ricketts勝出。
Fairshake主要金主包括Coinbase(COIN-US)、瑞波公司及創投公司Andreessen Horowitz。該組織支持32名眾議員候選人，包括19名共和黨人及13名民主黨人，篩選依據是對方是否支持產業的優先政策。
截至報導時，Fairshake投入資金的34場選戰中，已拿下29場，部分選戰仍未揭曉；但在投入至少100萬美元支持的6名眾議員候選人中，目前僅3人勝出，顯示整體勝率未能完全反映重點布局的成效。

民主黨掌國會添監管變數 比特幣收復跌勢

加密貨幣產業在過去兩個選舉周期合計投入約5億美元，試圖建立跨黨派國會盟友。2024年，業界協助數十名友善候選人當選，這些議員後來共同推動通過促進美元穩定幣採用的法律。
然而，《Clarity Act》推進受阻，加上民主黨取得國會控制權，意味產業接下來可能面臨更嚴格的監督，尤其是業界與川普之間的關係，以及川普涉及的加密貨幣商業活動。
Fairshake發言人Geoff Vetter表示，新當選與現任議員將面臨選擇，是保護消費者與美國就業，還是阻擋進步，顯示業界仍將持續爭取政策支持。
加密貨幣在選舉結果出爐後一度於隔夜下跌，但周三收復失地。比特幣截至報導時上漲3.1%，回到8萬美元以上，市場反應並未一路延續最初的悲觀情緒。
瑞波公司法務長Stu Alderoty在開票前表示，相較兩年前，加密貨幣產業的處境已有天壤之別。不過，談到民主黨可能調查川普的加密貨幣交易時，他也坦言，相關跡象已相當明顯。
paras_en: The crypto industry spent about $200 million on this U.S. midterm cycle; although most of the candidates it backed won, it lost several high‑stakes, heavily funded contests. With Democrats taking control of both chambers, the sector now faces not only legislative resistance but also the prospect of stricter congressional oversight and investigations due to its close ties with former President Trump.

The most notable setback occurred in Ohio. Democrat Sherrod Brown, who is skeptical of crypto, won a decisive victory to return to the Senate, despite the Crypto Political Action Committee pouring more than $60 million into efforts to block his election, which proved ineffective.

Heavy spending to stop Brown failed – the Ohio race was one of the most expensive Senate contests in history and is seen as a litmus test of crypto’s political clout. In September, Democrats blocked the Senate from advancing the pivotal “Clarity Act,” dealing a blow to an industry increasingly aligned with Trump.

Some progressive Democratic candidates also used their opponents’ ties to the crypto industry as a primary attack line during the primaries. Dominion analyst Jaret Seiberg said in a Tuesday report that these developments are worsening the political environment for crypto and prompting lobbyists to question whether the industry backed the right candidates.

Nevertheless, the industry did not lose across the board. The major super‑PAC Fairshake and its affiliates spent at least $13.5 million to oppose independent Senate candidate Dan Osborn in Nebraska, a race ultimately won by Republican incumbent Pete Ricketts, who had previously supported the “Clarity Act.”

Fairshake’s principal backers include Coinbase (COIN‑US), Ripple and venture firm Andreessen Horowitz. The group backs 32 House candidates – 19 Republicans and 13 Democrats – selected based on their support for the industry’s priority policies.

At the time of reporting, Fairshake had invested in 34 races, winning 29 of them, with some outcomes still pending; however, of the six House candidates it backed with at least $1 million each, only three have won so far, indicating that overall win rates do not fully reflect the impact of its targeted spending.

Democratic control of Congress adds regulatory uncertainty while Bitcoin rebounds. Over the past two election cycles the crypto sector has poured roughly $500 million into building bipartisan allies. In 2024 the industry helped dozens of friendly candidates get elected, who later worked together to pass legislation promoting the adoption of dollar‑stablecoins.

But the stalled “Clarity Act” and Democratic dominance in Congress suggest the industry may face tighter scrutiny, especially regarding its relationship with Trump and the former president’s crypto‑related business activities.

Fairshake spokesperson Geoff Vetter said newly elected and incumbent lawmakers will have to choose between protecting consumers and U.S. jobs or blocking progress, underscoring that the industry will continue to fight for policy support.

Crypto prices dipped overnight after the election results were announced but recovered on Wednesday. Bitcoin was up 3.1% at the time of reporting, climbing back above $80,000, and the market did not sustain the initial pessimism.

Ripple’s chief legal officer Stu Alderoty said that, compared with two years ago, the crypto industry’s situation has changed dramatically. He added that signs are already clear that Democrats may investigate Trump’s crypto transactions.

items.title: 美國民主黨勝選預期引爆避險潮 日股暴跌 日元走升
items.title_en: Democratic Victory Expected in U.S. Triggers Safe‑Haven Rally, Japanese Stocks Plunge, Yen Rises
paras: 受美國期中選舉開票序盤顯示民主黨居於優勢影響，市場擔憂人工智慧(AI)與資料中心可能面臨更嚴格的法規監管，引發日本市場周三(4日)出現強烈避險情緒。
日股周三跌勢於午後擴大，日經平均指數一度大跌逾2,800點，跌幅達4.6%，下探60,206點，跌破被視為關鍵支撐的200日移動平均線61,880。東證指數(TOPIX)同樣重挫3.3%。相較於股市受創，匯市則湧入避險買盤，美元遭遇拋售，日元兌美元升值0.7%至157.65附近。
本輪賣壓集中於AI與半導體類股，愛德萬測試(Advantest)一度重挫9.6%、軟銀集團(SoftBank Group)大跌10%，鎧俠(Kioxia)暴跌15%。賣壓並擴散至商社、機械及金融等類股。
SMBC信託銀行投資調查部長山口真弘分析指出，日股先前因企業財報強勁獲買盤支撐，加上前一日適逢日本國定假日休市，導致投資人進行補跌平倉，以及信用交易籌碼面不佳，加劇了賣壓。
針對市場焦慮，機構法人看法分歧。野村資產管理首席策略師石黑英之認為，當前走跌屬投機資金根據「民主黨交易」進行的機械式拋售，市場過度焦慮且過於短視。他指出，AI發展攸關美中霸權爭奪，趨勢難以止步，隨著企業基本面維持強勁，加上空頭回補，後續股價有望回升。
大和資產管理首席策略師建部和禮表示，眾議院過半已在預期中，焦點在於參議院開票。若民主黨僅微幅控制參議院，賣壓將於短期結束；若大勝過半，AI逆風恐將延續更長時間。
在匯市與展望方面，SMBC日興證券資深策略師丸山凜途指出，雖然民主黨優勢推升日元至157關卡附近，但考量美中競爭與總統否決權，嚴格規制難以實施，美元賣壓終將反轉。
藍天銀行首席市場策略師諸我晃補充，若民主黨奪下兩院，初期市場反應為避險與美元走弱，但當前美元拋售亦受到美股期指疲軟與中東地緣局勢緩和等因素影響。
paras_en: The market, worried that artificial intelligence (AI) and data centers could face tighter regulatory oversight, reacted to early mid‑term election results showing a Democratic advantage, sparking strong safe‑haven sentiment in Japan on Wednesday (the 4th).

Japanese equities fell sharply in the afternoon, with the Nikkei index at one point dropping more than 2,800 points—a 4.6% decline—to as low as 60,206, slipping below the key 200‑day moving average support of 61,880. The TOPIX also plunged 3.3%. In contrast, the currency market saw a rush of safe‑haven buying, the dollar was sold off and the yen rose about 0.7% to around 157.65 per dollar.

The sell‑off was concentrated in AI and semiconductor stocks, with Advantest tumbling 9.6%, SoftBank Group falling 10% and Kioxia plunging 15%. The pressure spread to trading houses, machinery and financial stocks as well.

SMBC Trust Bank’s head of investment research, Masahiro Yamaguchi, said the market had previously been supported by strong corporate earnings and, after a Japanese national holiday the day before, investors were forced to cover falling positions and weak margin‑trading balances, intensifying the sell pressure.

Institutional views diverged on the market anxiety. Nomura Asset Management chief strategist Hideyuki Ishiguro argued that the current decline is a mechanical sell‑off by speculative money reacting to a “Democratic trade,” and that the market is overly anxious and short‑sighted. He noted that AI development is tied to U.S.–China rivalry, the trend is hard to stop, and with solid corporate fundamentals and short covering, stocks could rebound.

Daiwa Asset Management chief strategist Kazuhide Kenbo said that the House of Representatives already being expected to tilt Democratic is only part of the story; the focus now is the Senate count. If Democrats only gain a slim Senate majority, the sell‑off should end soon; if they win a large majority, the AI headwind could persist longer.

Regarding FX and outlook, SMBC Nikko Securities senior strategist Rinto Maruyama pointed out that although the Democratic advantage has pushed the yen toward the 157 level, given U.S.–China competition and presidential veto power, strict regulation is unlikely to be implemented, and dollar‑selling pressure will eventually reverse.

Blue Sky Bank chief market strategist Sho Wataru added that if Democrats take control of both chambers, the initial market reaction will be safe‑haven buying and a weaker dollar, but the current dollar sell‑off is also being driven by weak U.S. equity futures and easing Middle‑East geopolitical tensions.

items.title: 〈美國期中選舉〉川普首度發聲：若我在選票上  共和黨將會「壓倒性」勝出
items.title_en: <U.S. Midterm Election> Trump Speaks for the First Time: If I Were on the Ballot, the GOP Would Win "Overwhelmingly"
paras: 美國總統川普對期中選舉結果首次作出回應，給選民的傳達的訊息是要假裝他在選票上，還說「如果我參選了，我們會以壓倒性優勢獲勝！」
川普周二(3日)晚間在Truth Social上寫道：「選票上又沒有我的名字——如果我在選票上的話，我們絕對會以壓倒性優勢獲勝！感謝大家關注此事。」川普此前便曾為了拉高投票率，懇請選民們假裝他就是這次選舉的候選人。
不過，隨著共和黨在全美遭遇慘敗，白宮也因為聲稱「川普總統不在選票上」而備受譏諷。
白宮稍早發出一份聲明說：「川普總統並不在選票上，事實證明，當川普在選票上時，他的支持者才會出來投票。此外，候選人素質至關重要，且川普總統在為許多候選人宣傳造勢方面，做得比候選人自己還要好。」
一位白宮官員還說：「今天投票支持民主黨的人，等到美伊衝突解決、汽油價格迅速回落時，恐怕會深感後悔，因為屆時他們將不得不面對這群激進的自由派民主黨人。最後還要說的是，無論今天結果如何，川普總統阻止『激進左派』的決心只會愈發堅定。大家繫好安全帶吧。」
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump responded to the midterm election results for the first time, urging voters to pretend he is on the ballot and saying, "If I were running, we would win by an overwhelming margin!"

On Tuesday night (the 3rd), Trump wrote on Truth Social: "My name isn’t on the ballot—if I were on the ballot, we would absolutely win by an overwhelming margin! Thanks everyone for paying attention to this." Trump had previously asked voters to pretend he was a candidate in order to boost turnout.
However, as the Republican Party suffered a crushing defeat nationwide, the White House was mocked for claiming that "President Trump is not on the ballot."

Earlier, the White House issued a statement saying: "President Trump is not on the ballot; the facts show that when Trump is on the ballot, his supporters turn out to vote. Moreover, candidate quality is crucial, and President Trump does a better job promoting many candidates than the candidates themselves do."

A White House official added: "Those who voted for the Democrats today will likely regret it once the Iran‑U.S. conflict is resolved and gasoline prices fall sharply, because they will then have to face this group of radical liberal Democrats. In any case, regardless of today’s outcome, President Trump’s resolve to stop the ‘radical left’ will only grow stronger. Everyone, buckle up.

items.title: 民主黨將橫掃國會！美元重挫創一個月低　瑞郎、日元成避險贏家
items.title_en: Democrats Set to Sweep Congress! Dollar Crashes to One-Month Low, Swiss Franc and Yen Lead as Safe-Haven Winners
paras: 美國期中選舉初步結果顯示，民主黨預計同時拿下參眾兩院，全球市場迅速重新定價。美元指數今(4)日在亞洲匯市早盤交易時段一度跌0.4%，創10月2日以來最大跌幅，瑞郎則升值近1%、日元升0.7%，雙雙成為外匯市場最大贏家，澳元表現落後。
市場核心擔憂在於「AI監管升溫」。法國農業信貸銀行策略師David Forrester指出，美元此輪強勢高度依賴AI熱潮與科技股資金流入，若民主黨勝選拖慢資料中心建設、加強產業監管，美元將直接承壓。美股科技族群與AI概念股因此面臨估值重估。
債市則反向受益。若政治僵局限制進一步減稅與政府支出，美債供給壓力下降，10年期殖利率走低、債價上漲。
Pepperstone研究主管Chris Weston指出，美元與美債實質殖利率同步走弱，加上對川普政府不確定性的對沖需求，推動今日亞洲早盤交易時段黃金買盤與期貨交易量明顯成長。
不過跌勢未必延續。三井住友日興證券的丸山凜人認為，若美伊談判破裂、油價反彈，通膨預期與Fed升息押注將重新升溫，進而支撐美元，且川普仍握有否決權，可擋下國會收緊AI監管的關鍵立法。短期「藍色浪潮」壓制美元，但地緣與政策反轉變數仍在。
paras_en: Preliminary results of the U.S. midterm elections show the Democrats are expected to win both chambers of Congress, prompting a rapid repricing in global markets. The dollar index fell 0.4% during the early Asian trading session on the 4th, its biggest drop since October 2, while the Swiss franc appreciated nearly 1% and the yen rose 0.7%, making them the biggest winners in the FX market, with the Australian dollar lagging behind.

The market’s core concern is “rising AI regulation.” David Forrester, a strategist at France’s Crédit Agricole, noted that the dollar’s recent strength has been heavily dependent on the AI hype and inflows into tech stocks; a Democratic victory that slows data‑center construction and tightens industry regulation would put direct pressure on the dollar. U.S. tech and AI‑related stocks could therefore face a valuation reassessment.

The bond market benefits in reverse. If a political stalemate curtails further tax cuts and government spending, pressure on U.S. Treasury supply eases, pushing 10‑year yields lower and bond prices higher.

Chris Weston, head of research at Pepperstone, said the dollar and real U.S. Treasury yields weakened together, and hedging demand amid uncertainty over a Trump administration boosted gold buying and futures volume noticeably during today’s early Asian session.

The decline may not continue. Rintaro Maruyama of Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities believes that if U.S.–Iran talks break down and oil prices rebound, inflation expectations and bets on Fed rate hikes could heat up again, supporting the dollar. Moreover, Trump still holds veto power, which could block key AI‑regulation legislation in Congress. The short‑term “blue wave” may suppress the dollar, but geopolitical and policy reversal risks remain.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】RBA第五度升息，未能提振澳幣
items.title_en: Far East Commercial Bank: RBA’s Fifth Rate Hike Fails to Boost the Aussie Dollar
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國10月供應管理協會(ISM)製造業採購經理人指數(PMI)改善，但9月建築支出意外較前月大幅下滑，並據美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)季度調查，第三季企業向銀行貸款需求放緩，為逾一年來首見，而且美國中期選舉臨近，根據預測機構數據，民主黨同時贏得參、眾兩院的概率為72%，美國總統川普領導的共和黨保住參議院、民主黨贏得眾議院的機率為23%。共和黨同時保住參、眾兩院的可能性僅6%，共和黨面臨失去國會控制權，同時民意調查顯示川普支持率已跌至其政治生涯最低水平，加上油價暴跌、美國收益率回落及本周迎來美國勞動力市場數據和多家央行決策，週二推動美元兌日圓下探至157.43低點。

隨後美國公布9月工廠訂單與耐久財訂單修正分別較前月增加1.8%及1.9%優於預期，並據美國勞工部數據顯示，9月職位空缺猛增至752.3萬個高於預估值及裁員數降至一年半來最低，而且美國對伊朗的格什姆島發動襲擊後，總統川普威脅要再打擊伊朗，伊朗官員則稱，美國伊朗所提要求的回應缺乏說服力，引發中東緊張局勢升溫，推升美元兌日圓至158.76高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.70-90，支撐於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD

昨日紐西蘭公布9月經季節調整新住宅建築許可數意外降7.9%遜於前值，並據澳洲央行(RBA)上調隔拆利率上調25個基點至4.85%，為今年第五次升息，更創十八年來新高，RBA表示將繼續採取其認為必要的措施，以使通貨膨脹率達到目標水平，但表決結果為九名委員中有三人主張維持利率不變，RBA則刪除必要時進一步上調隔夜拆利率的表述，市場普遍認為RBA將暫停加息，打擊紐元及澳幣下跌，拖累歐元兌美元受限於1.1206高點。

paras: 美元周二(3日)在小幅上漲與下跌之間來回震盪，投資人評估美國與伊朗可能達成協議的不確定性，以及美國期中選舉的結果。另一方面，澳幣與人民幣則在各自央行採取政策措施後走弱。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.07%，報101.83。
投資人正評估美國期中選舉可能造成的市場影響，尤其關注美國國會控制權是否可能出現轉變，以及民主黨若表現強勁，是否會導致資產價格波動加劇，特別是近來一直是市場主要驅動力的 AI 交易。
由於伊朗戰爭停火談判傳出相互矛盾的訊息，油價劇烈波動，美元當天也在小幅漲跌之間來回震盪。
一名伊朗高階官員向《路透社》表示，伊朗與美國距離達成結束戰爭的協議仍有很大差距。同時，調停方卡達加強斡旋，試圖縮小雙方分歧，避免美國期中選舉後局勢再次升高。
此外，美國總統川普表示，他已與以色列總理尼坦雅胡(Benjamin Netanyahu)達成協議，華盛頓將在今年年底後停止對以色列提供40億美元的資金，但仍會繼續向該國出售武器。
Monex USA交易部門資深主管 Juan Perez 表示，「我們現在收到的訊息非常混亂……情況就像是前進一步，接著又倒退一步。這讓人有些困惑，也有些沮喪。」
他接著表示，「我整體的看法是，美元仍有下跌空間，部分原因在於，聯準會(Fed)內部如今已不再有一致共識。另一個因素是，如果政府或政治層面的摩擦增加，而這種情況發生的可能性更高，那麼很可能會對美元造成負面影響。」
美元當天一度下跌0.17%，但在美國勞工部公布職缺與勞動力流動調查 (JOLTS) 報告後轉為走高。報告顯示，衡量勞動力需求的職缺數增加33.3萬個，達752.3萬個，遠高於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的710萬個。
這項數據是本週一系列美國勞動市場報告中的第一份，後續將於週五公布政府非農就業報告。這些數據將有助於形塑市場對聯準會未來政策走向的預期。
美國商務部另一份報告顯示，9月美國工廠商品新訂單增加1.8%，高於預測的1.2%，部分受到飛機訂單增加的帶動。
澳幣與人民幣承壓
另一方面，市場也對中國與澳洲央行稍早公布的政策決策作出反應。
中國人民銀行提高金融機構必須持有的外匯存款準備金比例，以減緩人民幣近期升值的速度。受此影響，美元兌離岸人民幣上漲0.35%，至6.67，創下5月15日以來最大單日漲幅。
澳洲央行如市場預期，將現金利率調升25個基點至4.85%。這是今年第五次升息，決策結果為6票贊成、3票反對。澳幣盤中一度下跌0.51%，最新兌美元下跌0.4%，報0.6968美元。
高盛分析師在一份報告中表示，他們認為這項決策「略偏鴿派」，理由包括決策委員會投票結果出現分歧、聲明中刪除了強調緊縮傾向的措辭，以及更新後的預測顯示，截尾平均通膨率 (trimmed mean inflation) 到2028年第四季將放緩至2.4%。
本週還有其他央行將公布政策決策，包括英國、挪威與瑞典的央行。

paras_en: The dollar on Tuesday (the 3rd) swung back and forth between modest gains and losses as investors weighed the uncertainty over a possible U.S.–Iran agreement and the outcome of the U.S. midterm elections. Meanwhile, the Australian dollar and the Chinese yuan weakened after their respective central banks took policy actions.
In the New York close, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.07% to 101.83.

Investors are assessing the market impact of the U.S. midterms, especially the prospect of a shift in control of Congress and whether a strong showing by Democrats could spark heightened asset‑price volatility, particularly in AI‑driven trading that has been a key market driver lately.
Conflicting messages from Iran‑war cease‑fire talks sent oil prices sharply up and down, and the dollar also oscillated within a narrow range on the day.

An Iranian senior official told Reuters that there remains a large gap between Iran and the United States on reaching a war‑ending deal. At the same time, Qatar, acting as a mediator, stepped up its efforts to narrow the differences and prevent the situation from escalating again after the U.S. midterms.

U.S. President Donald Trump also said he has reached an agreement with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that Washington will cease providing $4 billion in funding to Israel after the end of this year, though it will continue to sell weapons to the country.

Juan Perez, senior head of the trading division at Monex USA, said, “The information we are getting now is very chaotic… it feels like taking a step forward and then a step back. It’s confusing and a bit frustrating.”

He added, “My overall view is that the dollar still has room to fall, partly because the Fed no longer has a unified consensus internally. Another factor is that if government or political frictions increase – which is more likely – it could have a negative impact on the dollar.”

The dollar fell as much as 0.17% during the day but turned higher after the U.S. Labor Department released its Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS). The report showed job openings rose by 333,000 to 7.523 million, well above Reuters‑survey economists’ estimate of 7.10 million.

This data was the first of a series of U.S. labor‑market reports due this week, with the government’s non‑farm payrolls slated for release on Friday. Those figures will help shape market expectations for the Fed’s future policy path.
Another report from the U.S. Commerce Department showed that new orders for factory goods in September rose 1.8%, above the 1.2% forecast, helped in part by an increase in aircraft orders.
Australian Dollar and Chinese Yuan Under Pressure
Elsewhere, markets also reacted to policy decisions announced earlier by the People’s Bank of China and the Reserve Bank of Australia.

The People’s Bank of China raised the reserve‑requirement ratio for foreign‑exchange deposits that financial institutions must hold to slow the recent appreciation of the yuan. As a result, the offshore yuan rose 0.35% against the dollar to 6.67, marking the biggest single‑day gain since May 15.

The Reserve Bank of Australia, as markets expected, lifted the cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85%. It was the fifth rate hike this year, with the decision passing 6‑3. The Australian dollar fell as much as 0.51% intraday and was down 0.4% at $0.6968 per U.S. dollar.

Goldman Sachs analysts wrote in a note that they view the move as “slightly dovish,” citing the split vote on the committee, the removal of language emphasizing tightening in the statement, and updated forecasts showing trimmed‑mean inflation slowing to 2.4% by Q4 2028.
Other central banks are set to announce policy decisions later this week, including those of the United Kingdom, Norway and Sweden.
The euro rose 0.07% against the dollar to $1.1193.
The pound sterling gained 0.11% against the dollar to $1.3418.
The yen weakened 0.47% against the dollar to ¥158.66 per $1.

paras_en: Onshore and offshore Chinese yuan both depreciated against the U.S. dollar today (the 3rd). As of 9:35 a.m. local time, the onshore yuan was at 6.6632 per dollar, down 0.23% intraday, while the offshore yuan was at 6.6617 per dollar, down 0.22% intraday. The move follows the People’s Bank of China’s decision to tighten foreign‑exchange liquidity management for financial institutions by raising the foreign‑exchange deposit reserve ratio by two percentage points, from the current 4% to 6%, effective November 15 of this year.

Previously, the PBOC emphasized in its policy stance on the yuan that looking ahead, the factors influencing the exchange rate are diverse, with forces pushing both appreciation and depreciation, making the future direction of the yuan uncertain.

Market analysts say that raising the FX deposit reserve ratio effectively tightens the supply and liquidity of dollars in the foreign‑exchange market, which can ease upward pressure on the yuan and help keep the yuan‑dollar rate at a reasonably balanced, fundamentally stable level.

Since the start of the year, the yuan has appreciated sharply, with offshore yuan gaining about 4.5% against the dollar. Today the central parity rate for the yuan was lowered by four basis points to 6.715, compared with 6.7146 in the previous trading session.

paras: 美元周一(2日)走勢疲軟，油價大幅下挫，美國公債殖利率也隨之回落。本週市場將迎來一連串重要事件，包括美國期中選舉、美國勞動市場多項經濟數據，以及多國央行的利率決策。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌 0.22%，報 101.76，盤中一度跌至 101.42，創下 9 月 30 日以來新低。
由於伊朗與卡達官員持續就結束美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭進行談判，市場對中東地區石油供應中斷情況可能緩解的期待升高，原油價格因此暴跌約 7%。
油價回落最初帶動美國股市上漲，但科技股再度走弱。iPhone製造商蘋果在公布財報前下跌約 2%；甲骨文（Oracle）則因計劃透過發行債券與股票籌資 200 億美元，股價重挫逾 8%。
近幾週，市場對企業在新興 AI 技術上投入龐大資金的疑慮日益加深，拖累股市表現，也使美元受惠於避險需求而獲得支撐。
Bannockburn Capital Markets 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「整體而言，市場展現出相當強的韌性。12 月交割的西德州中級原油（WTI）期貨價格週五一度測試每桶 105 美元，如今已跌破 100 美元。」
他接著表示，「週末前，市場情勢看起來相當糟糕。股市下跌，12 月 WTI 原油期貨更創下合約新高。但週末過後重新開市，市場彷彿集體鬆了一口氣。」
即使惠譽（Fitch）在上週五稍晚，因法國債務狀況持續惡化，將法國的信用評等展望從「穩定」調降至「負面」，歐元兌美元仍上漲 0.3%，來到 1 歐元兌 1.1192 美元。
10 月製造業指數上升
在經濟數據方面，美國供應管理協會（ISM）公布，10 月製造業採購經理人指數（PMI）從 9 月的 54.5 上升至 55.5，顯示製造業活動持續擴張，而投入成本仍維持在較高水準。
本週市場也將迎來一系列勞動市場數據，並以週五美國政府公布的 10 月非農就業報告作為重頭戲。
標普全球（S&P Global）公布的歐元區製造業 PMI 顯示，10 月歐元區製造業活動仍維持良好的成長態勢，不過成長速度略有放緩，主要原因是新訂單成長減速，加上能源價格與供應鏈中斷造成成本上升，進一步壓縮企業利潤空間。
本週也有多家央行預計公布貨幣政策決議，包括英國、澳洲、挪威及瑞典央行。
美國選民將於週二前往投票所，決定民主黨是否從美國總統川普所屬的共和黨手中奪回國會控制權。經濟狀況與物價高漲是選民關注的主要議題。
市場普遍預測，民主黨有望贏得眾議院多數席次，但要進一步取得參議院控制權，難度可能較高。
英鎊兌美元上漲 0.1%，來到 1 英鎊兌 1.3406 美元。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，英國製造業在 2026 年最後一季開始時，產出成長創兩年多來最強勁的表現。不過，快速攀升的成本可能令英國央行(BoE)感到憂慮，市場預期英國央行本週可能升息。
美元兌日元上漲 0.23%，來到 157.89 日元。

paras_en: The dollar was weak on Monday (the 2nd), and oil prices fell sharply, with US Treasury yields also retreating. This week the market will face a series of important events, including the US midterm elections, multiple US labor market data releases, and interest‑rate decisions by several central banks.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.22% to 101.76, after dipping intraday to 101.42, a low not seen since September 30.

Because Iranian and Qatari officials continued negotiations to end the US‑Israel war with Iran, market expectations that disruptions to Middle‑East oil supply might ease rose, sending crude oil prices down about 7%.

The oil‑price drop initially lifted US equities, but tech stocks weakened again. Apple, the iPhone maker, slipped about 2% ahead of its earnings release; Oracle fell more than 8% after announcing plans to raise $20 billion through a bond and stock offering.
In recent weeks, concerns have deepened that companies are pouring huge sums into emerging AI technologies, dragging down equity performance and giving the dollar a boost as a safe‑haven asset.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Capital Markets, said, "Overall, the market has shown considerable resilience. December‑delivery West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude futures tested $105 a barrel on Friday and have now slipped below $100."

He added, "Going into the weekend, market conditions looked pretty grim. Stocks were falling and December WTI futures had even set a new contract high. But after the weekend, when trading resumed, the market collectively seemed to breathe a sigh of relief."
Even though Fitch last Friday downgraded France’s credit outlook from "stable" to "negative" amid worsening debt conditions, the euro still rose 0.3% against the dollar to €1 = $1.1192.
October manufacturing index rises

On the data front, the US Institute for Supply Management (ISM) reported that the October manufacturing PMI rose to 55.5 from September’s 54.5, indicating continued expansion in factory activity while input costs remain elevated.
The market this week will also see a slew of labor‑market data, with Friday’s US non‑farm payroll report slated as the headline event.

S&P Global’s euro‑area manufacturing PMI showed that October manufacturing activity in the euro zone remained robust, though growth slowed slightly as new‑order growth decelerated and higher energy prices and supply‑chain disruptions pushed up costs, further squeezing corporate profit margins.
Several central banks are also expected to announce policy decisions this week, including those of the United Kingdom, Australia, Norway and Sweden.

US voters will head to the polls on Tuesday to decide whether Democrats can wrest control of Congress from the Republican Party of President Trump. Economic conditions and rising prices are the main issues for voters.
The market broadly expects Democrats to win a majority of seats in the House, but gaining control of the Senate is seen as a tougher challenge.
The pound rose 0.1% against the dollar to £1 = $1.3406.

PMI data show that UK manufacturing output at the start of the final quarter of 2026 posted its strongest growth in more than two years. However, rapidly rising costs could worry the Bank of England, and markets anticipate a possible rate hike this week.
The dollar gained 0.23% against the yen, reaching ¥157.89 per $1.
In its full quarterly economic outlook report, the Bank of Japan noted that Japan’s real interest rate has recently risen, especially in the long‑term and ultra‑long‑term rate segments.
